BER-RENT-01.reason: This is an annual adjustment order implementing Berkeley's rent-control law for fully covered units. The underlying operative rent-increase-limit law and its coverage are better captured by the ordinance coverage record; annual board orders are duplicates of the same law for this category.

BER-JC-02.reason: Relocation assistance for owner move-in and Ellis Act evictions is part of Berkeley's just-cause eviction law and related implementation ordinances. It is a subsidiary provision of the same law family; keep the broader just-cause record as the main record for this category.

BOS-JC-01.reason: This ordinance requires delivery of a tenant-rights/resources notice and city filing when ending a tenancy or non-renewing, but it expressly does not limit the grounds for eviction or nonrenewal. In just-cause eviction, notice provisions are keepable when part of a just-cause regime; here the record is only a procedural notice tied to eviction and non-renewal, not an operative just-cause rule.

CA-DEP-02.reason: This record mainly states that application screening fees are excluded from the definition of security under the deposit statute and are governed by the separate application-screening-fee law; it does not itself impose an operative security-deposit rule.

HOB-JC-01.reason: This record only defines 'just cause for eviction' by cross-reference to New Jersey state law and does not itself provide operative local causes, notice, coverage, or relocation rules in this category.

LA-RENT-P02.reason: This motion concerns possible regulation of algorithm-based rent-setting software, not an operative rent increase limit or rent-control/preemption rule.

LA-JC-03.reason: These demolition/new-construction occupant protections function as a subset of no-fault eviction protections and procedures within Los Angeles just-cause eviction regulation. Keep the broader city just-cause rule record; drop this narrower implementing/procedural protection as part of the same law area for one-record-per-law purposes.

LA-ALG-P01.reason: A motion directing a report/study creates no operative prohibition or substantive algorithmic rent-setting rule; it is a procedural study item only.

MA-RENT-P04.reason: This pending bill concerns algorithmic rent setting, not rent increase limits, and the provided materials contain no operative rent-cap or local rent-control rule in this category.

MA-RENT-P03.reason: This pending bill concerns algorithmic rent fixing/algorithmic rent setting rather than rent increase limits, and no substantive rent-cap rule is provided.

NJ-RENT-02.reason: Same state-law rent-control framework as NJ-RENT-01; this record is an exemption from local rent control for newly constructed multiple dwellings, while NJ-RENT-01 better states the main operative statewide rule for this category. Exemption/coverage provisions of the same law framework should be deduplicated.

NJ-JC-02.reason: This record addresses owner-occupied two- and three-family dwelling coverage/exception rules under the same Anti-Eviction Act framework and is best treated as part of the same law/category entry rather than a separate law record. Keep the broader main just-cause record.

SD-ALG-01.reason: Same enacted law as SD-ALG-02, cited by ordinance number rather than codified municipal code sections. Keep the codified record as the best statement of the operative rule.

SF-JC-02.reason: Relocation-payment amounts for specified no-fault evictions are part of the same just-cause eviction law and are ancillary to the main operative just-cause rule already captured in SF-JC-01.

SF-DEP-01.reason: This record gives only the annual interest rate on security deposits and expressly lacks any maximum deposit amount; it does not state an operative security-deposit rule for this category as defined.
